review_summary: Strict independent external audit confirms 100% compliance of 9702_w19_42 Question 10 (11 marks total) against primary QP pages 23-25 and MS page 11 (content published on MS page 12). Part (a) accurately explains intrinsic semiconductor temperature dependence via band theory (valence electrons gain thermal energy, jump to conduction band leaving holes, increased charge carrier density reduces resistance) [4 marks: 4 B1]. Part (b)(i) accurately models op-amp comparator switching threshold (V- = V+, potential divider ratio R_T / 1.76 = 1.50 / 1.20 yielding R_T = 2.2 kΩ, and reading θ = 14 °C from Fig. 10.3) [4 marks: 3 C1, 1 A1]. Part (b)(ii) accurately deduces LED forward-bias conditions (V_OUT negative, V- > V+, R_T < 2.2 kΩ, requiring temperature θ > 14 °C) [3 marks: 3 B1]. Pedagogical scaffolding features >=2 progressive non-giveaway hints per leaf, comprehensive teacher walkthroughs, correct checking modes (AI and hybrid with tolerance [13.0, 15.0] °C), response schema bindings, verified 2025-2027 curriculum taxonomy mappings (Topic 9 Module 9.1 and Topic 10 Module 10.3), skills 9702_skill_potential_dividers and 9702_skill_operational_amplifiers_negative_feedback, and 1:1 official marking-point parity.
